exhaustive -h
stdout ^$
stderr -count=3 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive \[-B\] \[-casenil\] \[-d\] .+'
stderr -count=1 '\[-typeonly regexp\] \[packages\]$'

! exhaustive -invalid
stdout ^$
stderr -count=4 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^flag provided but not defined: -invalid$'
stderr -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive .+'
